snippet.title: Everise Demo Trailer - New Dungeon Crawler Coming out Soon
snippet.description:
Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012410/Everise/

Get to the top of the Tower before raiders destroy your town.
Break the furniture and loot monsters along the way, then extract these resources down balconies to build up and defend your town.

Not the final trailer, I'll make a new one for the full game release :)
